Turn email notifications on or off. Account emails are sent either way.

post.description: Revoke this session. Other signed-in sessions stay active.

get.description: The member's interview, for resuming where they left off.

post.description: Start the interview and get the first question. A member with a book can't start again (409).
Write the waiting question again after a failed attempt (a 502, or `question` is null).
Answer the waiting question. The answer is saved first, then the next question is written.
Confirm the Librarian's playback ("Yes, that's me"), or correct it.
End the interview and get three titles, each with why it's you.
Choose one of the three titles. The book is finished to match and saved as a draft.

delete.description: Remove a chapter from the draft. The blurb is rewritten for the chapters that are left.

post.description: Put the finished book on the shelf. The interview is then done.

get.description: Books you've checked out, and open checkouts of your book.

post.description: Check out a book with a short message to its author.
Withdraw a checkout the author hasn't answered yet.
Say yes to a checkout of your book.
Say no to a checkout of your book. The reader sees "this book isn't available right now".
